statement: In Atraḫasīs, humans are created so that they can take over labor previously performed by the gods; the creation uses clay together with the flesh/blood of a slain god in the surviving tradition. The epic later narrates attempts to reduce or destroy the expanding human population, culminating in a flood from which Atraḫasīs is warned and survives.
